file_change.purpose: Verify functional-set, normative, Plan, Planning Assurance, and executability rules.
implementation: Construct minimal temporary Design, functional-set, and modular Plan artifacts.
Assert core/extension identity rules, exact Design revision binding, scope-only functional-set behavior, normative ID uniqueness, and Conformance/Assurance applicability rationale.
Assert duplicate/conflicting target paths, missing implementation intent, unresolved validation references, missing dependency paths, and predecessor mismatch fail Plan Conformance.
Construct modular Plan fixtures rooted at plan.json and assert complete resolution across requirements, file plans, execution, invariants, validation, and completion documents.
Assert missing, duplicate, conflicting, unreachable, unauthorized, path-traversing, and plan_id-mismatched Plan subdocuments fail independently.
Assert Plan acceptance requires externally produced bootstrap Planning Assurance for FS0 and governed semantic review for successor functional sets.
Assert explicit delegation and Core default-deny authorization resolve without implementation/history inference.
Assert bootstrap Planning artifacts remain Planning artifacts and do not change the declared implementation predecessor.
Do not test deferred mature NR-quality automation, generalized lifecycle mutation, derived/product provenance registries, or full validation correspondence closure in FS0-Core.
